_help: Nova's expressions. Each expression picks ONE file from each layer folder, by file name without the extension (case, spaces and dashes don't matter: "Squint Forward" = "squint-forward").
Layer folders: assets/image/nova/x1/body, eyes, brows, mouth (+ the same in x2/ and x3/). Drawn bottom to top: body, mouth, eyes, brows.
Lines in story.json and in equipment scripts (speaker "scientist") choose "expression" and "body". Leave them out to use defaultExpression / defaultBody.
mouth = her mouth when she's quiet. While her text types, the mouth flips between it and the talk mouths (talkMouths, or talk.mouths if the expression has none).
blink.eyes = the closed eyes used for blinking. Set "blink": false on an expression whose eyes are already closed.
poses = the old pose names (idle / talk / wave / point) still work in lines; this says which body each one means.
New expression: copy one, rename it, pick other files. A typo shows a red box listing the valid names.
